chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hajjal, from Thalabah, from a man he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The meal of the night is more beneficial than the meal of the day.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating dinner according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) asserts that the evening meal is more beneficial than the daytime meal, a view supported by classical physicians like Ibn Sina who noted that digestion is more efficient during the cooler evening hours. This narration, found in al-Kafi’s chapter on the merits of dinner, underscores the Prophetic tradition of prioritizing the evening meal for optimal health and spiritual well-being, encouraging believers not to neglect this practice.
